Mask cleanup · CT / MRErode shrinks the edge. Opening removes small protrusions with less shrinkage. Closing fills small holes and notches, but may join nearby regions. Review changes before accepting.

Navigate: click moves the 3D cursor; wheel changes slice; drag adjusts window / level; Shift-drag zooms. Segment: target/background points collect one combined fill proposal; local CT seed immediately adds 30–100 HU voxels. Shape-aware grow can start inside the mask and adds a local proposal; shape-aware shrink removes a local excess on CT or MR. Hold for the boundary pause, release to apply, and use Undo. Cleanup is separate: cyan marks proposed removals, mint marks proposed additions. Check nearby slices before accepting a change.
